name: Slakar Charger [Racial]
body:
What’s worse than being charged down by a slakar? Being charged down by three slakar on triceratops.

Prerequisite(s): Slakar, BAB +6, protected charge

Benefits: After successfully hitting an opponent with a charge attack, you grant yourself and up to two adjacent allies a +2 shield bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. This bonus stacks with an existing shield bonus, but only increases it by +1 unless the creature has made a charge attack.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
